sql: SELECT Track.Name, Album.Title, Artist.Name FROM Track JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Rock'

question: show jazz tracks with album name
sql: SELECT Track.Name, Album.Title FROM Track JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'

question: show customers from usa total spending
sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Customer.Country = 'USA' GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(Invoice.Total) DESC

question: top 5 customers from usa by spending
sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Customer.Country = 'USA' GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(Invoice.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: show invoice count and total per customer country
sql: SELECT Customer.Country, COUNT(Invoice.InvoiceId), SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.Country ORDER BY SUM(Invoice.Total) DESC
